pictures.title: View of the entrance to the Monument to the children in Yad Vashem
pictures.author: Bahnfrend
pictures.observations: Actually viewed: rough low cave mouth, hewn approach stones, fieldstone wings, unfinished pillar group beyond. No copied pixels, portrait or lettering.

pictures.title: Children's Monument at Yad Vashem, designed by Moshe Safdie
pictures.author: Joshuapaquin (Flickr)
pictures.observations: Actually viewed: varied square pale pillars, rough broken/chamfered tops, staggered rows and low fieldstone support. Inventory and dimensions remain picture-led.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Children's Memorial, Yad Vashem: exterior-only rock-cut entrance, low sloping stone-lined approach, hewn blocks rising toward a rough bedrock arch, closed cave roof and finite dark rear, adjoining fieldstone support and twenty picture-led unfinished square pillars with broken heads. Keep original ground around the pillar field and outside the entrance. No mirrored candle chamber, recordings, portrait, copied inscriptions/dedication imagery or independent campus buildings.
